items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: I met him on one of those George Gruntz tours. He came and said hi to everybody.

ctx.x: The direction. Because he wasn’t usually, he wasn’t after subtlety.
No. Do you know the famous line from the great – oh God now I can’t say his name. There was as great lead trumpet player – Al Porcino.
Oh yes. That’s right. I’ve heard this story. Yes.
